## Other changes **Harness reconciliation and upfront plans, 2026-11-10 ([PR #15](https://github.com/voidbrain/gauntlet-protocol/pull/15)).** Adopt published v4.7.0 (harness PR97/98/99), source-owned records and optional featurePlans enforcement. Initial exact migration preserved all ledger bytes before enabling derived step tables. F-008/F-009 each have three anticipated steps with dated effort, status, dependencies and uncertainty. Native metadata imports/optional explicit launcher preserve source/privacy limits; no model call, download, client configuration, native exporter or production permission follows. No behaviour runner is configured; rule-following and actual session tokens remain unmeasured. Shared reconciliation work spans both features and is explicitly unallocated rather than duplicated. Validation:43 deterministic tests, typecheck/build/index, work/backlog/rules/harness/audit/integration and impact checks pass. Review: independent fresh-context consumer_plans_review found no content blocker; no app/model acceptance claimed. Boundary clarification2026-11-10 ([PR #13](https://github.com/voidbrain/gauntlet-protocol/pull/13)): external-runner contract supplies no coding sandbox. Worktrees/process supervision/hashes do not enforce hidden-test confidentiality; that requires independently accepted runner/grader isolation. PROTOCOL/EVIDENCE now state these limits explicitly. Documentation-only; no new isolation implementation or live campaign. README/AGENTS/area notes/backlog rules/style guide reviewed for consistency. F-007 accepted in v0.4.1 after PR #11 / CI42686856664 and independent review;43 deterministic tests. No real-model campaign. F-006 released in v0.4.0 after PR #9 / CI42679371024 and independent report-only review;41 deterministic fixtures and packaging/static checks passed. Private capture and selected diagnostics are accepted independently of consumer adoption. No live model campaign or native client source verification. F-005 released in [v0.3.0](https://github.com/voidbrain/gauntlet-protocol/tree/v0.3.0) after PR7 exacthead170611f / CI42607576561 passed all35 deterministic tests and owned packaging/contract checks. Fresh-context strict-enum finding fixed after committed failing regressione7f7183 and rechecked. No model/load campaign or consumer adoption gates the release. F-002/F-003/F-004 released in v0.2.0 from PR #5, CI42572655186 and independent report-only review; neutral deterministic acceptance only. No consumer adoption or live model qualifies the shared release. B-001 closed against PR #3, CI 42534614317 and independent report-only review; release v0.1.1. This documentation reconciliation adds no runtime work. PR #1 implemented the independent protocol; CI 42533767427 and fresh-context review accepted it. F-001 archived in [2026](archive/backlog-2026.md). PR #2 reconciled and archived F-001 with CI 42534060898 passed; no model qualified. ## How to use this file | Status | Requirements | Next statuses and conditions | Priority cue | |---|---|---|---| | **🔴 Open** | Reproducible bug or agreed capability; scope and next action recorded. | - **Investigate** if cause/scope is uncertain
- **Implemented** when code is complete
- **Blocked** if a named dependency prevents progress
- **Closed** if cancelled/superseded, with reason. | Coloured | | **🟠 Investigate** | Report and unanswered question recorded; next diagnostic identified. | - **Open** when scope/cause is established
- **Implemented** when fixed
- **Blocked** if evidence/dependency is unavailable
- **Closed** if duplicate/not reproducible after documented investigation, with reason. | Coloured | | **🟡 Implemented** | Code exists; required verification remains pending. | - **Verified** when all acceptance checks pass (automated ones: the merged PR's green CI run)
- Open or Investigate if a check fails
- **Blocked** if a required check cannot proceed. | Coloured | | **🟢 Verified** | All acceptance checks passed; date, method and evidence recorded, including human/device checks when required. | - **Closed** when no action remains and resolution is recorded
- **Open** or **Investigate** if new evidence invalidates verification. Do not leave completed items here indefinitely. | Coloured | | **🟣 Blocked** | Specific blocker, affected work/check and resume condition recorded. | - Return to **Open**, **Investigate** or **Implemented** when unblocked
- **Verified** only after all checks pass
- **Closed** if cancelled/superseded, with reason. | Grey ◻️ | | **🔵 Closed** | Resolution recorded and item archived. | - **Open** or **Investigate** if reopened by new evidence
Retain ID, original Opened date and historical closure record. | Grey ◻️ | Follow [Backlog rules](BACKLOG-RULES.md) for updating records, reconciling PR/CI evidence, stale-state review, closure/archiving, human dependencies and table validation. Preserve stable IDs and existing user edits. Each item shows its ID and title, a signal table (priority, status, remaining effort), Human action required (🧑 Yes / 💻 No), and Issue / Reproduce / Check. Expand the closed details for next actions, estimate rationale, PR history, dates and verification. Effort: 🟢 Small ≤1 day · 🟡 Medium 2–3 days · 🔴 Large ≥4 days. Status and verification evidence describe progress; effort is an estimate of work still required. A `---` line ends every item.
